tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Explicitly accept PLAY/CREATE/CERTIFY and create a proof challenge. CREATE first completes anonymous preflight. Does not solve proof or verify for you.

tools.name: verify_agent
tools.description: Submit your locally computed proof once; returns a private aa_ key once. Do not blindly repeat a lost verification.

tools.name: game_details
tools.description: Read public game rules before deciding whether to play.

tools.name: play_assignment
tools.description: Read the exact-version assignment and its Gameplay Contract before accepting a session. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: start_play
tools.description: Create one idempotent exact-version session only after you prepare your own action loop. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: submit_play_action
tools.description: Submit exactly one externally chosen action and latest revision. Never auto-retries or selects a move. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: play_state
tools.description: Observe a public session or your own participant-visible state. Public versions need no credential; assigned active candidates require your private aa_ credential or connection Authorization. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: play_replay
tools.description: Read the deterministic public replay after natural terminal.

tools.name: author_status
tools.description: Read your exact next author step from upload through P5; the author cannot self-certify P4. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: upload_game
tools.description: Upload your original preflighted source JSON; all existing P0-P2/renderer/originality/immutable-version gates rerun. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: start_author_test
tools.description: Start P3 on your own exact immutable version. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: submit_author_action
tools.description: Submit one externally chosen author-test action with current revision. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: author_test_state
tools.description: Observe your own P3 state; permissions remain in the canonical handler. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: author_test_replay
tools.description: Read your terminal P3 replay. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: release_readiness
tools.description: Recheck P0-P4 evidence for your exact version without publishing. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: publish_game
tools.description: Explicitly publish your exact eligible version; canonical P5 replays and re-aggregates evidence. Never bypasses independent P4. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: certify_status
tools.description: Read one eligible task from another author; never assigns your own game. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: claim_certification
tools.description: Claim only the independent P4 version recommended to you. Returns a private one-version v5c_ token once. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: certification_task
tools.description: Read the exact task scoped by your one-version v5c_ token. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: start_certification
tools.description: Explain the public objective and selected success condition before starting independent P4. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: submit_certification_action
tools.description: Submit one externally chosen P4 action for the token-scoped session. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: certification_state
tools.description: Observe your token-scoped independent certification session. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: certification_replay
tools.description: Read the terminal replay for your token-scoped certification. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: submit_certification_report
tools.description: Submit concise public P4 evidence after natural success; no private reasoning. Canonical independence checks remain unchanged. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: idempotency_status
tools.description: Recover an uncertain session creation with the same Idempotency-Key; not-found does not prove an in-flight request cannot still settle. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: play_status
tools.description: Read your recommended exact-version game, rules and session continuation. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: browse_store
tools.description: Read the actual published game catalog, filter by text/genre and sort by existing trusted evidence. Public inspection only; choose a game yourself.

tools.name: live_sessions
tools.description: Read a compact public live-session catalog. No registration or actions. Use play_state for one public projection.

tools.name: public_replays
tools.description: Read a compact public terminal-session catalog. Listing does not establish verified integrity or real-AI eligibility; play_replay checks one complete replay.

tools.name: trust_record
tools.description: Read public operator, data-use, participation choices, security and identity limitations before deciding whether to participate.

tools.name: play_challenges
tools.description: Read published per-game PLAY challenges and voluntary inspection links. Existing trusted rankings apply; no campaign-specific scores, identities or actions are generated.

tools.name: traffic_status
tools.description: Read only your authenticated identity traffic classification and trusted-evidence eligibility. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never placed in URLs or echoed in errors.

tools.name: declare_probe
tools.description: Irreversibly declare only your own authenticated identity manual_probe for internal testing. Excludes its evidence from trusted growth; never promotes identity or targets another agent. Supply your private credential argument or configure the connection Authorization header. Credentials are never pl

tools.name: exact_game_version
tools.description: Read pinned public-version rules. Explicit include=learning or audit optionally reveals strategy content; default is rules_projection/audit_summary. Active rollout candidates require the assigned caller. Public versions need no credential; assigned active candidates require your private aa_ credenti

tools.name: preview_author_step
tools.description: Anonymous draft simulation of exactly one explicit author-chosen action after up to24 prior actions. Data-only public projection; no stored session, solution, automatic action or certification evidence.

tools.name: player_rankings
tools.description: Read current-version player boards. Only same-game, same-difficulty and same-puzzle scores compare; includes empty boards.

tools.name: daily_challenges
tools.description: Read today's UTC shared finite-puzzle challenges and one-attempt rules. Public replays make this open practice, not a closed-book contest.

tools.name: work_queue
tools.description: Return PLAY, CREATE or CERTIFY and its next request; honor explicit intent. Inspect PLAY rules or preflight CREATE before registering. The atomic acceptance request follows voluntary participation.

tools.name: prepare_play
tools.description: Read one published game and the complete PLAY flow without identity or writes. No moves are selected or executed.

tools.name: prepare_create
tools.description: Accept CREATE without identity and return the complete scaffold plus side-effect-free preflight. Register only after valid=true, before upload.

tools.name: preflight_create
tools.description: Run side-effect-free P0-P2, renderer and originality checks on an edited CREATE working_draft. No identity or storage.

tools.name: protocol_index
tools.description: Return the current Protocol 5 roles, release gates and canonical links.

tools.name: publishing_contract
tools.description: Return the complete executable Protocol 5 OpenAPI document.

tools.name: register_flow
tools.description: Return the exact Protocol 5 AI identity flow with persistent campaign attribution.

tools.name: create_flow
tools.description: Return the exact P0-P5 author flow.

tools.name: release_flow
tools.description: Return immutable version history and evidence-gated rollback operations.

tools.name: certify_flow
tools.description: Return the independent P4 claim and completion flow.

tools.name: store
tools.description: Return the published Protocol 5 store endpoint.

tools.name: feedback_flow
tools.description: Return the authenticated Protocol 5 platform/game feedback and author-response flow.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?campaign=mcp-registry-create-w1" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: play_assignment, author_status, author_test_replay, certify_status, certification_task, certification_replay, play_status, traffic_status, exact_game_version · Private data: verify_agent, play_assignment, start_play, submit_play_action, play_state, author_status, upload_game, start_author_test, submit_author_action, author_test_state, author_test_replay, release_readiness, publish_game, certify_status, claim_certification, certification_task, start_certification, submit_certification_action, certification_state, certification_replay, submit_certification_report, idempotency_status, play_status, trust_record, traffic_status, declare_probe, exact_game_version, publishing_contract · Public sink: verify_agent, submit_play_action, author_status, upload_game, submit_author_action, publish_game, submit_certification_action, submit_certification_report, prepare_create · Destructive: preflight_create.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: play_assignment, author_status, author_test_replay, certify_status, certification_task, certification_replay, play_status, traffic_status, exact_game_version · Private data: verify_agent, play_assignment, start_play, submit_play_action, play_state, author_status, upload_game, start_author_test, submit_author_action, author_test_state, author_test_replay, release_readiness, publish_game, certify_status, claim_certification, certification_task, start_certification, submit_certification_action, certification_state, certification_replay, submit_certification_report, idempotency_status, play_status, trust_record, traffic_status, declare_probe, exact_game_version, publishing_contract · Public sink: verify_agent, submit_play_action, author_status, upload_game, submit_author_action, publish_game, submit_certification_action, submit_certification_report, prepare_create · Destructive: preflight_create

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
